topic: 数据比较与图表描述入门
grammarFocus: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词。
title: Comparing Data in a College Survey
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先阅读题目，听第一遍时抓住大意，听第二遍时记录关键数字和比较信息。所有答案必须来自录音原文。
transcript:
M: Hi, Lin. You look busy. What are you working on?
W: Oh, hi, Mark. I’m looking at the results of our college survey. We asked 200 students about their study habits.
M: Two hundred? That’s a good number. What did you find?
W: Well, the biggest group—about 45 percent—said they study in the library. Another 30 percent study at home. The rest, 25 percent, study in cafes or other places.
M: So the library is the most popular. What about the time they spend studying?
W: Last year, students studied about 10 hours a week on average. This year, it’s 12 hours. So there was an increase of 2 hours.
M: That’s interesting. Did you compare first-year and final-year students?
W: Yes. First-year students study about 9 hours a week, but final-year students study 15 hours. So final-year students study 6 hours more than first-year students.
M: That’s a big difference. What about the number of students who use online materials?
W: Two years ago, only 20 percent used online materials regularly. Now, it’s 60 percent. There was a sharp rise.
M: Wow, that’s three times more. Did you ask about part-time jobs?
W: Yes. In the survey, 40 percent of students have a part-time job. But last year, it was 50 percent. So there was a decrease of 10 percent.
M: Why do you think that is?
W: Maybe because more students study longer hours now. But I’m not sure.
M: Did you find any other trends?
W: Well, the number of students who study in groups increased from 15 percent to 25 percent. And individual study decreased from 70 percent to 55 percent.
M: So group study is becoming more popular. What about the library? Was it busier this year?
W: Yes, the library reported 500 more visits per week this year compared to last year. Last year there were 2,000 visits per week; this year there are 2,500.
M: That’s a 25 percent increase in visits. Good work, Lin. This data is really useful.
W: Thanks, Mark. I’m presenting it to the class tomorrow.

questions.prompt: How many students took part in the survey?
questions.explanation: 录音开头女士说“We asked 200 students about their study habits.”，因此参与调查的学生人数是200。
questions.evidence: We asked 200 students about their study habits.

questions.prompt: What percentage of students study in the library?
questions.explanation: 女士提到“about 45 percent—said they study in the library”，所以图书馆学习的学生比例是45%。
questions.evidence: about 45 percent—said they study in the library

questions.prompt: This year, students study ______ hours a week on average. (Use a number.)
questions.explanation: 女士说“This year, it’s 12 hours.”，因此平均每周学习12小时。

questions.prompt: How many more hours do final-year students study than first-year students?
questions.explanation: 女士比较说“final-year students study 6 hours more than first-year students”，所以多6小时。
questions.evidence: final-year students study 6 hours more than first-year students

questions.prompt: What was the percentage of students using online materials two years ago?
questions.explanation: 女士说“Two years ago, only 20 percent used online materials regularly.”，两年前是20%。
questions.evidence: Two years ago, only 20 percent used online materials regularly.

questions.prompt: The percentage of students with a part-time job decreased by ______ percent. (Use a number.)
questions.explanation: 女士说“there was a decrease of 10 percent”，所以下降了10个百分点。
questions.evidence: there was a decrease of 10 percent

questions.prompt: How did the percentage of students studying in groups change?
questions.explanation: 女士说“the number of students who study in groups increased from 15 percent to 25 percent”，所以是从15%增加到25%。
questions.evidence: the number of students who study in groups increased from 15 percent to 25 percent

questions.prompt: How many library visits were there per week last year?
questions.explanation: 女士说“Last year there were 2,000 visits per week”，去年每周有2000次访问。
questions.evidence: Last year there were 2,000 visits per week

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: Comparing survey data about study habits
answers: Comparing survey data about study habits
questions.explanation: 对话围绕学习习惯调查结果的比较展开，包括学习地点、时间、在线材料使用等，因此主题是比较调查数据。
questions.evidence: I’m looking at the results of our college survey. We asked 200 students about their study habits.

options: Present the data to the class
answers: Present the data to the class
questions.explanation: 女士最后说“I’m presenting it to the class tomorrow.”，所以明天她将向班级展示数据。
questions.evidence: I’m presenting it to the class tomorrow.

vocabulary.example: We asked 200 students about their study habits in our college survey.
About 45 percent said they study in the library.
Students studied about 10 hours a week on average last year.
There was an increase of 2 hours in study time.
There was a decrease of 10 percent in part-time jobs.
Did you compare first-year and final-year students?
Did you find any other trends?
The library is the most popular place to study.

grammar.title: 比较结构、百分比与数量表达、there was/were、趋势动词
grammar.explanation: 比较两个事物时，可以用 more/less + 名词，或者形容词比较级 + than。百分比用“数字 + percent”，数量用“数字 + 名词”。表示过去某处有某物，用 there was（单数）或 there were（复数）。描述趋势常用动词如 increase（增加）、decrease（减少）、rise（上升）、fall（下降）。
grammar.example: Last year there were 2,000 visits per week; this year there are 2,500.

questions.prompt: There ______ 50 students in the library yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语50 students是复数，且时间为yesterday，所以用there were。
questions.evidence: Last year there were 2,000 visits per week

questions.prompt: The number of online learners increased ______ 20% to 60%.
questions.explanation: 表示从某个数值增加到另一个，用from...to...结构。
questions.evidence: the number of students who study in groups increased from 15 percent to 25 percent

questions.prompt: Final-year students study 6 hours ______ than first-year students.
questions.explanation: 比较级结构“more than”表示“比……多”。
questions.evidence: final-year students study 6 hours more than first-year students

questions.prompt: There was a sharp ______ in the use of online materials.
questions.explanation: a sharp rise是固定搭配，表示“急剧上升”，rise在此作名词。
